instruction.text: Hamza is always complaining. Choose the correct <u>antonym</u> to complete his sentences.

atoms.a: Time is moving so quickly today. I wish time was moving more. blank.
atoms.b: “Time is moving so quickly today. I wish time was moving more ((++slowly fast)).”

atoms.a: “We went to see a film the other day, and the ending was so predictable. I wish it had had more of a blank ending.”
atoms.b: “We went to see a film the other day, and the ending was so predictable. I wish it had had more of ((++an_unexpected a_typical)) ending.”

atoms.a: “This cake is so dry, I wish it was blank”
atoms.b: “This cake is so dry, I wish it was ((++moist tasty))”

instruction.text: Jessie is going on a trip. Choose the correct <u>antonym</u> to complete her sentences.

atoms.a: I’m pretty sure we’re going the wrong way, and we got lost last time. Do you know the blank way to go?
atoms.b: “I’m pretty sure we’re going the wrong way, and we got lost last time. Do you know the ((++right scenic)) way?”

atoms.a: Before we set off, my boots were so clean. Now, they’re really blank.
atoms.b: “Before we set off, my boots were so clean. Now, they’re really ((comfy ++dirty))”.

atoms.a: The weather today is freezing, which is so weird because it was blank yesterday.
atoms.b: “The weather today is freezing, which is so weird because it was ((mild ++boiling)) yesterday”.

instruction.text: Write the correct <u>antonym</u> in the gap to complete this diary entry.

atoms.b: Last week, we travelled to Edinburgh. I was hoping the train ride would be short, but it was really ((long)).
On the first day, we went to an exhibition. I was expecting it to be really boring, but it was in fact extremely ((interesting)).

The main reason for our trip to Edinburgh was to go to a concert. My sister got the tickets for my birthday. I thought it would have been hard to get tickets, but she said it was actually really ((easy)).
